name: Six pop-up texts on a picture
what: Your picture fills the frame and six short texts pop in around its subject one after another - each starts small and blurred, springs a little past its size and settles - in white with a soft warm glow.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: the picture drifts in about 3 % (the reference's photo has smoke moving in it); text 1 pops in at f3, text 2 at f5, text 3 at f11, text 4 at f25, text 5 at f31, text 6 at f36 - each starts small (x0.5) and blurred, overshoots to x1.22 two frames later, rebounds to x1.04 and settles at x1 by +6 f; then everything holds
